ko: 참 반가운 성도여 다 이리 와서
en: O come, all ye faithful, joyful and triumphant, O come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem!
Come and behold Him born the King of angels! O come, let us adore Him, Christ the Lord!
O Sing, choirs of angels, sing in exultation, O sing, all ye citizens of heaven above!

ko: 주 하나님 앞에 늘 영광을 돌려
en: Glory to God, all glory in the highest! O come, let us adore Him, Christ the Lord!
For God of true God, this world's divine Redeemer,In grace condescending to be truly man,
Despis'd not the womb of virgin, sweet and lowly O come, let us adore Him, Christ the Lord!
O Yea, Lord, we greet Thee, born this happy morning, O Jesus, to Thee be all glory given

ko: 늘 감사한 찬송을 주 앞에 드려
en: Word of the Father, now in flesh appea-ing! O come, let us adore Him, Christ the Lord!
